notes: Outputs are computed from the discovered source artifact; no values are imputed.
granularity_note: Each row is one trial collapsed onto its single nearest MNPS window (8s window / 4s step); multiple trials commonly share a window. rmcorr/LOSO/bootstrap treat trials as repeated, subject-clustered measurements, not independent samples.
scope_note: No rest-vs-illusion contrast is possible (no rest EEG in ds004587); no Jacobian/MNJ trial-locking is available.
